purpose: Single source of truth for distinguishing scheduled live runs of the graded DCA task from manual runs, so downstream slippage/watchdog/weekly reporting never confuses the two. Every run_state artifact must carry a run_classification block matching this policy.
accepted_state_schema_versions_note: Downstream consumers (slippage 67aa802b, weekly 041d9d90) accept BOTH run-classification-v1 and the stricter successor run-classification-v2-preauthorized when the required scheduled identity fields (run_origin, manual_run, cron_id/supersedes_cron_id, scheduled_for_et, window, run_id) are correct. v2 (added 2026-07-10) is the pre-authorized direct-placement contract (no review_equity_order); it is a stricter successor of v1, not a different contract, so a v2 scheduled run_state is valid scheduled evidence and must not be discarded for its version alone.

scheduled_run_classification.writer_contract: Every scheduled 3:30 PM ET run_state MUST be written with BOTH cron_id='10ce362c' AND supersedes_cron_id='ce16ba6b'. order_submit_status_values.not_submitted_no_candidates: No ticker qualified for a buy; run_state is valid scheduled evidence with no orders.
order_submit_status_values.not_submitted_confirmation_required: Robinhood review passed but order submission was blocked by required post-review user confirmation. Valid scheduled evidence that the task ran; carries no order_id and is NOT evidence of an order/fill.
order_submit_status_values.not_submitted_error: An error prevented submission; run_state is still valid scheduled evidence and records the error.
order_submit_status_values.not_submitted_budget_exhausted: Budget/cap left no room to submit; valid scheduled evidence with no orders.

rules: Before computing any signal, persist every raw Robinhood/Finance/Alpaca connector response used by the run under scheduled_runs/YYYYMMDD_1530ET/raw/ with the deterministic filenames above.

rules: Any connector response that returns an output_path or current_session_context pointer MUST be immediately copied or normalized into the run's raw directory BEFORE compute (follow the pointer, load the referenced payload, persist as parseable JSON with contents under 'data' and the original pointer under 'output_path').
Compute must read only the persisted raw files, never in-memory tool responses.
Pointer-only collection is NOT a completed run; the task must not stop after collecting data without writing run_state.

If pointer normalization fails after one bounded recovery attempt, write the valid failure-state file with a concrete error_class (e.g. pointer_normalization_failed or missing_or_invalid_raw_inputs), empty submitted_orders.csv headers where applicable, and a compact list of the missing pointer details.

rules: Validate scheduled state files against run_classification.schema.json before use.

Accept BOTH run-classification-v1 and run-classification-v2-preauthorized scheduled run_state files: a v2 run_state is valid scheduled evidence when the required scheduled identity fields are correct and must not be excluded for its state_schema_version alone.
Collect every order_id found under the manual-exclusion roots (see manual_exclusion_roots) and exclude them from all scheduled-live metrics.
Exclude any run_state whose run_classification has run_origin='manual' or manual_run=true, regardless of where the file is located on disk.
Never infer scheduled status from same-day broker orders alone; a valid scheduled run_state must exist.
Scheduled-live cost basis, slippage, reliability, and order-count metrics must be computed only from validated scheduled runs with manual order IDs excluded.

A scheduled run_state with order_submit_status='not_submitted_confirmation_required' is valid scheduled-run evidence that the task ran but is NOT evidence of an order/fill: it contributes zero scheduled fills/order IDs and must not be marked invalid because confirmation blocked submission.

Exclude final manual buy overrides (run_type='final_manual_buy_override', valid_afternoon_scheduled_evidence=false, same_day_top_up_context_only=true) from scheduled slippage, scheduled fills, scheduled reliability, scheduled cost basis, and watchdog confirmation. Show them only in a labeled Manual Final Buy Override / Same-Day Top-Up Context section (see manual_reporting).

Exclude manual missed-morning recovery artifacts (under morning_dca/manual_recovery/**, run_origin='manual', manual_run=true, same_day_top_up_context_only=true, valid_scheduled_evidence=false) from scheduled slippage, scheduled fills, scheduled reliability, scheduled cost basis, and watchdog confirmation. They never prove the 10:30 scheduled task ran and are used only as same-day prior-allocation / top-up context (see manual_missed_morning_recovery).

Exclude the 2026-07-21 manual midday run (under midday_dca/manual_runs/**, run_origin='manual', manual_run=true, stream='midday_manual', same_day_top_up_context_only=true, valid_scheduled_evidence=false, valid_afternoon_scheduled_evidence=false) from scheduled slippage, scheduled fill counts, scheduled reliability, scheduled cost-basis evidence, watchdog proof, and scheduled afternoon evidence. It never proves the 12:30 or 3:30 scheduled tasks ran and is used only as same-day prior-allocation / top-up context by the later 3:30 top-up logic (see midday_manual_run_2026_07_21).

Historical (until 2026-08-02): the watchdog (a46bf007) queried ALL same-day Robinhood equity orders for account <ROBINHOOD_ACCOUNT_NUMBER> WITHOUT a placed_agent filter first, then classified every order by scheduled evidence, manual artifacts, same-day top-up roots, placed_agent, and order IDs; orders with placed_agent='user' or any non-agentic value appeared in a Manual/User Orders section and counted as scheduled fills only when their order IDs were in a valid scheduled submitted_orders.csv from the same-day scheduled run (see watchdog_all_orders_fix_2026_07_21). final_buy_behavior.summary: For the final live buy of the day (the 3:30 PM ET task 10ce362c), perform a full active-universe scan and ignore the 60-minute downward-trend filter FOR THE FINAL-BUY DECISION ONLY. Every other guard still applies.
final_buy_gates: Full active-universe scan (all whitelisted tickers), not a shortlist.
Ignore the 60-minute downward-trend filter for the final-buy decision ONLY (morning 10:30 and midday 12:30 live runs still require trend validation unless changed later).
Still require current/decision price strictly below the prior completed regular-session close.
Still require multiplier > 0 from the $2-base 0x-to-5x ladder.
Still require budget pass (daily/weekly caps, buying power, per-order ceiling).
final_buy_behavior.same_day_top_up_guard: Apply the same-day top-up guard across morning, midday, manual, and final override streams: for a ticker with same-day prior buy context, the comparison reference is that ticker's most recent valid same-day buy reference (ordered by generated_at); buy only the incremental difference corrected_delta_usd = max(0, desired_usd - effective_prior_usd), and only if the final decision price is strictly lower than that most recent reference. A missing prior reference => no auto-top-up (conservative $0 / manual_review_candidate).
final_buy_behavior.trend_note: Morning (10:30) and midday (12:30) live runs still require trend validation. The trend filter is ignored ONLY for the final-buy decision on 10ce362c.

final_manual_override.summary: A final manual buy override is the final-buy behavior invoked manually (e.g. after the scheduled 3:30 PM run placed 0 orders). It ignores trend and applies same-day top-up offsets, but is manual by contract: excluded from every scheduled metric and used only as prior-allocation context for same-day top-up. Reported only in the Manual Final Buy Override / Same-Day Top-Up Context section.

foreground_primary_surrogate_context_202.problem: On a trading day the operator drives in the foreground, the background scheduled stream legitimately writes no artifact. Both close-of-day validators escalated a missing-scheduled-evidence alert for that day, reporting an outage that did not occur. A recurring false alert erodes trust in the alert that matters.
recognised_markers: foreground_primary_surrogate_context (bare marker string, as a field value or a list entry)
foreground_primary_surrogate_context_202.marker_sources: Same-day run_state.json, run_summary.json, latest pointers, and manifest entries. Searched at the top level and in the run_classification, classification, foreground_primary, foreground_primary_context, run_summary, and summary blocks.
foreground_primary_surrogate_context_202.same_day_requirement: A marker counts only when the artifact carrying it declares trading_day equal to the current ET trading day. Prior-day markers, and markers on artifacts that declare no trading_day, are rejected. Without this, a single foreground day would silence the missing-scheduled-evidence alert permanently, the same failure mode same_day_pointer_validation_policy exists to prevent.
foreground_primary_surrogate_context_202.marker_matching: Exact equality only, never substring. A marker named inside a prose note is documentation, not a declaration, and substring matching would let a note that says the run was NOT foreground primary switch the mode on. The boolean spellings require literal true, so the string "false" and the integer 0 are not declarations.
foreground_primary_surrogate_context_202.effect_when_active: Report foreground_primary_mode_active=true, list the foreground artifact paths used, and classify those fills/orders as foreground_primary_surrogate_context. Do not escalate a missing or invalid background scheduled evidence alert solely because the scheduled run artifact is absent, incomplete, or valid_scheduled_evidence=false.

evidence_separation.rule: Foreground and manual fills are execution CONTEXT for user-approved foreground primary operation. They are never scheduled evidence for the background stream, and never scheduled slippage, scheduled fill-count, scheduled reliability, or scheduled cost-basis evidence. There is no code path in scripts/foreground_primary.py that flips these three flags.
evidence_separation.relationship_to_same_day_top_up_policy: Unchanged. Foreground primary mode explains why the background stream produced nothing. It does not promote a top-up context artifact to scheduled evidence, and the existing recovery-context contract (run_classification.validate_recovery_classification) is untouched.

invalid background scheduled artifacts when foreground primary mode is NOT active
foreground_primary_surrogate_context_202.suppression_is_narrow: Only the missing/invalid background scheduled evidence finding is suppressible. Every finding in still_escalate escalates regardless of foreground primary mode: the mode explains an absent background run, it does not excuse a failure.
foreground_primary_surrogate_context_202.relationship_to_watchdog_all_orders_fix_: No conflict. That fix widened what the watchdog must LOOK AT (all same-day orders, no placed_agent filter) and is unchanged here. This patch changes only whether an ABSENT background scheduled artifact escalates.
foreground_primary_surrogate_context_202.relationship_to_watchdog_reconciliation_: No conflict. That patch narrowed what may be COUNTED as a final-run submission and is unchanged here. A foreground artifact is never final-run evidence under either policy.

utc_window_rule.requirement: Final-run reconciliation MUST use the true final-run scheduled window. 3:30 PM ET is 19:30Z during EDT, so the lower bound is 19:30Z.
utc_window_rule.forbidden: 18:30Z MUST NOT be used as the final-run lower bound. 18:30Z is 2:30 PM ET, a different scheduled slot, and using it sweeps the entire afternoon intraday window into the final run.
utc_window_rule.dst_note: 3:30 PM ET is 19:30Z during EDT and 20:30Z during EST. Derive the instant from the ET slot; do NOT hardcode 19:30Z year-round.
utc_window_rule.consistency_with_existing_fallback: broker_time_window_fallback scopes attribution to a CLOSED window whose start depends on the run identity: 15:20-15:35 ET (19:20Z-19:35Z during EDT) for a CANONICAL scheduled_YYYYMMDD_1530ET state, and 15:15-15:35 ET (19:15Z-19:35Z during EDT) ONLY for a LEGACY scheduled_YYYYMMDD_1520ET state -- see scripts.run_classification._attribution_window_start_min. This field previously reported 15:15-15:35 for all runs, which would let a consumer attribute an otherwise-unclaimed 15:15-15:24 order to a current 3:30 run that the code correctly refuses (codex review: 'Report the canonical broker fallback window accurately'). Both variants remain narrower than, and consistent with, the rule above; all of them exclude 18:30Z.

final_run_evidence_definition: an order_id present in the final run's own submitted_orders.csv
a ref_id present in the final run's own submitted_orders.csv
a ref_id carrying the final-run ref_id prefix, when the final run stamps one
an order created INSIDE the true final-run scheduled UTC window -- at or after 19:30Z AND at or before 19:35Z during EDT -- that is NOT already claimed by an earlier stream artifact

time_fallback_window_bounds.dst_note: Both bounds are DERIVED from the ET slot and must be recomputed under EST (20:30Z-20:35Z). Do NOT hardcode the Z values year-round; the same rule already stated for the lower bound applies to the upper.
time_fallback_window_bounds.why_bounded: The rule previously stated only a lower bound, so ANY later same-day order not already claimed qualified indefinitely -- a manual or unrelated order placed at 16:00 ET would be attributed to the 3:30 scheduled run and swept into scheduled watchdog and slippage results. An unbounded 'final-run evidence' test is not a window (codex review: 'Cap the final-run time fallback at the window end').
time_fallback_window_bounds.consistency_with_code: scripts.run_classification._in_scheduled_window_et enforces a CLOSED window for the same fallback -- 15:20-15:35 for a canonical 1530ET run, 15:15-15:35 for a legacy 1520ET one. This rule's upper bound is that same 15:35 end; its lower bound is deliberately the slot time itself, which is the stricter of the two.
time_fallback_window_bounds.precedence: Unchanged: this is still the LAST resort. Artifact-linked evidence (order_id, ref_id, final-run ref_id prefix) is checked first, and the earlier-stream-claim exclusion still applies before the window test runs.

watchdog_reconciliation_scope_patch_2026.evidence_ordering: Check artifact-linked evidence FIRST (order_id, then ref_id, then final-run ref_id prefix). The time-window test is the LAST resort and is valid only after the earlier-stream-claim exclusion has been applied.

snapshot_classification.broker_context_all_same_day: A broad same-day raw broker snapshot. Useful as context and required for the all-orders reconciliation, but never a substitute for final-run submissions.
snapshot_classification.filename_is_not_scope: A raw file named for the final run, such as raw/final1530_rh_orders.json, records only WHEN the snapshot was taken, not WHICH stream placed the orders in it. The filename MUST NOT be read as a scope claim.

zero_order_pass_rule.outcome: PASS. Earlier same-day orders present in raw broker context MUST NOT fail the watchdog.
zero_order_pass_rule.escape_hatch: Fail only if MATCHING final-run order evidence contradicts the artifact, meaning an order satisfying final_run_evidence_definition exists while the artifact claims zero orders. That remains a real discrepancy and must alert.
zero_order_pass_rule.rationale: A zero-order final run is a legitimate outcome. On any day with earlier activity the broad snapshot is never empty, so treating a non-empty snapshot as a contradiction would fail every zero-order final run on every active day.

rules: Compare ONLY final-run evidence when reconciling the final run against the broker.
Never treat a broad same-day raw broker snapshot as the final run's submission set; it is broker_context_all_same_day.
Never use 18:30Z as the final-run lower bound; the true EDT lower bound is 19:30Z, derived from the 15:30 ET slot.

Never apply the time-window test with a lower bound alone. The window is CLOSED at both ends (15:30-15:35 ET, 19:30Z-19:35Z during EDT); an order created after the window closed is not final-run evidence no matter what else is true of it.

Never record a broker order as reconciled on the strength of a HUMAN attribution alone. If no validator can resolve the owning artifact, it stays a residual discrepancy until the artifact is repaired.
Never count an order already claimed by an earlier stream artifact as final-run evidence.
A zero-order final run with earlier same-day context present is same_day_prior_context_present and PASSES.

The 2:33 PM ET EVR recovery order stays same-day top-up context ONLY: never final-run evidence, never afternoon scheduled evidence, never slippage scheduled proof, never scheduled cost-basis evidence.

rules: Query all same-day equity orders for robinhood:<ROBINHOOD_ACCOUNT_NUMBER> with NO placed_agent filter before any reconciliation; do not start from the agentic-only subset.
Classify every returned order by scheduled evidence, manual artifacts, same-day top-up roots, placed_agent, and order IDs.

Orders with placed_agent='user' or any non-agentic value are reported in a dedicated Manual/User Orders section and MUST NOT count as scheduled fills unless their order IDs appear in a valid scheduled submitted_orders.csv from the same-day scheduled run.
The agentic-only (placed_agent='agent') subset MAY be reported separately as context but is never the primary reconciliation set.
Manual fills stay excluded from scheduled slippage, scheduled fill counts, scheduled reliability, scheduled cost-basis evidence, watchdog proof, and scheduled afternoon evidence.

raw_input_generation.summary: The 3:30 scheduled final live task MUST NOT assume runner inputs already exist. Before invoking any saved runner or order module, it MUST create the raw directory and persist all required raw inputs for the current same-day run.

historical / trend bars needed for the trend check
raw_input_generation.run_date_arg: If a runner requires a RUN_DATE_ET argument, pass the current America/New_York date as YYYYMMDD.

raw_input_generation.bounded_recovery: If raw input generation fails once, perform ONE bounded recovery attempt with the alternate approved data source path, then stop.

state_file_guarantee.summary: The 3:30 scheduled run MUST always write run_state.json, run_summary.json, and latest_scheduled_run.json even when execution is blocked, is a no-op, or errors.

blocked_state_required_fields.error_class: Concrete class such as missing_or_invalid_raw_inputs or no_incremental_top_up.
blocked_state_required_fields.missing_inputs_field: Include a compact list of missing files, block reasons, or failed data sources.

state_file_guarantee.evidence_meaning: This failure-state artifact is valid proof that the 3:30 scheduled task FIRED, but it is NOT order or fill evidence.
state_file_guarantee.post_raw_failure_rule: If any step fails after raw collection has started, write the signals.csv when possible, an empty submitted_orders.csv with headers when no orders were placed, and run_state.json. Do not leave a half-done run with no state file.
state_file_guarantee.manual_recovery_exclusion: Manual recovery artifacts (missed-morning under morning_dca/manual_recovery/** and manual 12:30 under midday_dca/manual_recovery/**) remain prior-allocation / top-up context only. They are NEVER afternoon scheduled evidence, slippage, reliability, fill-count, or cost-basis evidence.

rules: Include run-classification-v2-preauthorized scheduled runs in weekly metrics when the required scheduled identity fields are present; do not drop them for their state_schema_version.

conditions: A valid scheduled run_state exists (run_origin='scheduled', passes schema validation).
The scheduled run_state lacks order IDs due to a known/recorded write failure.

Only broker orders inside the scheduled window on the scheduled trading day may be attributed. The window START depends on the run identity: 15:20-15:35 ET for a CANONICAL scheduled_YYYYMMDD_1530ET state, and 15:15-15:35 ET ONLY for a LEGACY scheduled_YYYYMMDD_1520ET state. This condition previously read 15:15-15:35 for every run, which permitted attributing an otherwise-unclaimed 15:15-15:24 order to a canonical 3:30 run that scripts.run_classification._attribution_window_start_min() correctly refuses -- the authoritative block has to state the rule the code enforces, not a superset of it (codex review: 'Correct the actual broker fallback contract').
constraints: Manual order IDs (from manual_runs/**/run_state*.json) must still be excluded even under fallback.
Fallback is never allowed when no valid scheduled run_state exists.
Fallback must not attribute orders from a run classified as manual.
